The honest note that #13628's naming convention was currently holding (and is now pinned structurally against a doctored neighbour, both directions) is exactly the standard of evidence this file's subject demands. The asymmetric extractor failure modes (unknown key throws, missing anchor returns empty so ablations stay readable) are documented in place.

Out-of-scope finding #13650 (H19's unterminated clause) correctly filed rather than folded — the rendered line stays untouched here as adjudicated. Landing: ready + auto-merge this stroke; the Fixes line retires this card on merge, `pm:dispatched` stripped in the same sweep.
